notes: The source page is the Golden West College 2026-2027 Local General Education (Associate Degree Graduation Requirements) page, not a section titled CSU General Education Breadth; the closed list matches this local GE course list, so its Areas are recorded as the blocks. A reviewer should confirm this page is the right source for the CSU GE Breadth certificate.

The page states 'Completion of a minimum of 24 units as listed under Areas 1 through 7E' for local GE; this is a minimum for the GE pattern used for the associate degree, not a stated total for this certificate, so total_units is left null. The 60-unit and 18-unit major sentences apply to all associate degrees and are not recorded as totals.

Area tabs for AREA 5: Natural Sciences, AREA 6: Ethnic Studies and AREA 7E: Lifelong Understanding and Self-Development are named on the page but their course lists are not in the provided text (cut off); no blocks were recorded for them. Closed-list courses from those areas (e.g., ANTH G185, ASTR, BIOL, CHEM, GEOL, PHYS, PE, ATHL, COUN, KIN, HLED G100) are not in this part.
Area 2 and Areas 3 and 4 print 'Select a minimum of 3 semester units' with no block total; stated left null.
ENGL C1000/C1000E, MATH G115/G115S, MATH G140/G140S and STAT C1000/C1000E print a single range 4-6 on the first row; the alternatives have no units printed beside them.

The catalog prints reciprocal 'or' pairs as two rows (ECON G120 or HIST G110 and HIST G110 or ECON G120; PHIL G150 or PSCI G150 and PSCI G150 or PHIL G150 in Area 3; ETHS G120/GEOG G120, ETHS G103/PSCI G103, ETHS G133/SOC G133, ETHS G134/SOC G134, ETHS G181/PSCI G181, ECON G120/HIST G110 in Area 4). Each pair is recorded once, under the first-printed row.
ART G139 matches the closed-list entry 'ARTG139' (History of Graphic Design) printed without a space; treated as the same course, catalog_addition false.
THEA G115, G125 and G135 print units '1,2'; recorded as 1 to 2.
The 1A and 1B headings say '(3 units)'; recorded as stated 3 although ENGL C1000 is printed at 4-6 units and ENGL C1003 at 4.

Closed-list ART G105/G106, ECON G170/G175, ENGL G110/G112 appear to correspond to catalog C-ID codes ARTH C1100/C1200, ECON C2001/C2002, ENGL C1003/C1002 printed in the text; the C codes are recorded as catalog additions.

Part 2: The source page is the Golden West College Local General Education / Associate Degree Graduation Requirements page, not a section for the CSU General Education Breadth Certificate of Achievement; the award named may not match this page. Reviewer should verify the correct source (CSU GE Breadth pattern).

Part 2: Only the tabs for Areas 1-4 are printed in the text; Areas 5 (Natural Sciences), 6 (Ethnic Studies) and 7E (Lifelong Understanding) are listed by heading but their course lists are missing, so many closed-list courses could not be placed.

Part 2: The page states 'Completion of a minimum of 24 units as listed under Areas 1 through 7E' and 'additional elective units to total 60 units' as general associate degree rules; not recorded as this certificate's total_units or degree_total.
Part 2: ge_pattern left null because the page itself is a GE pattern (local GE) rather than a degree naming one; the award is a GE certificate.
